title: How to Build a Marketplace App
summary: Build a two-sided marketplace with Stripe Connect, seller listings, buyer checkout, and platform fees. No $50K dev agency needed — build it with AI in days.
body_markdown: Your admin panel includes a dispute resolution queue where either party can flag an order. For chargebacks, Stripe Connect provides built-in dispute management with evidence submission tools. Adding seller verification requirements — ID check, portfolio review, or phone number — before allowing listings to go live reduces fraud risk significantly.
